<thought>Each distinct chemical shift in the 13C NMR spectrum corresponds to a unique carbon environment. The spectrum shows nine different shift values (166.40, 144.78, 132.00, 130.07, 127.80, 52.24, 49.55, 43.55, 19.23). Therefore, there are nine chemically equivalent carbon types.</thought>
<final_answer>9</final_answer>
